verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Terraform has versioned releases (e.g., v1.16.0, v1.7.0) and versioned providers/modules via the Registry, but there is no documentation of a formal, publicly stated API/versioning deprecation policy that an AI-native integrator could rely on. Probes for API specs (openapi.json, llms.txt) all 404, and no docs item addresses deprecation guarantees or lifecycle policy. Missing for 10: explicit deprecation policy documentation, versioned API/OpenAPI spec, and any evidence of backward-compatibility guarantees for agentic consumers.
